version.reason: `difficulty` is not gated by language version; iterating the EVM target shows the built-in/reserved flip at Paris.

expected_solc_divergence.reason: From Paris the `difficulty` opcode is superseded by `prevrandao`, so slang's availability-gated built-in check no longer fires and the declaration falls through to acceptance. solc keeps the name reserved from Paris on (DeclarationError 5017). Pre-Paris the two agree (the built-in still exists, so both reject). Reserving names that are no longer available needs a separate reserved-identifier check; remove this divergence once that lands.
